description: Adjacency and rhythm rules for the thirteen templates. `adjacency` is derived from every consecutive pair in templates/templates.json (extraction check recomputes it). Rules carry a severity; semantic_validate.py implements each rule id listed here and verify_all.py checks the two agree. Rules GENERATED_MODE_* and REFERENCE_MODE_ROLE are the mode layer: they apply to the PageSpec `mode` field (reference | generated).

rules.text: shell.navbar is the first node on every page and appears once.
shell.footer is the last node, except that utility overlays (shell.youtube-overlay, shell.app-dialog, shell.image-lightbox) may follow it.
Utility sections (shell.youtube-overlay, shell.app-dialog, shell.image-lightbox), when present, are the final nodes: nothing but utility sections follows the first one.

Every section type appears at most once per page, except sections the page's template declares repeatable (content.post-card, content.release-entry, store.app-list), which stay contiguous and within the template's maxCount.
Any hero.* section (hero.landing-hero, hero.page-title, hero.page-header, hero.awards-hero), when present, directly follows shell.navbar.
rules.exception: template.not-found and templates without a hero (noHero).

rules.text: template.not-found contains no hero, showcase, features, support, cta, commerce or store nodes.

Every videoId in hero.landing-hero (introVideoId, secondaryCta.videoId) and features.feature-grid (demoVideoId) matches a videos[].id in shell.youtube-overlay, and a page that references any video includes the overlay.
showcase.persona-tabs.initialTab equals one of its tabs[].id.
On a persona route the initialTab equals the template's routeInitialTab value; on / it equals constraints.requiredInitialTab.

navbar.activeLinkHref equals the template's navActiveLinkHref ('/' on the landing page, '/pricing', '/blog' for the index and posts, '/changelog', '/store' for the store and its categories; persona, legal, download, awards, app-detail and 404 mark none).
A tab of kind apps carries apps[], a tab of kind logos carries logos[]; the schema enforces it, the validator also checks at most 4 entries.
At most one icon-press-and-burst section per page.
Tab ids, FAQ questions, pricing plan ids, store shelf titles and node ids are unique within a page.

Utility overlays (shell.youtube-overlay, shell.app-dialog, shell.image-lightbox) are retrievalEligible:false. A PageSpec node may not claim retrievalEligible:true for a section whose contract says false, and the pinned utility set in semantic_validate.UTILITY_SECTIONS may never be eligible.
A closing conversion block (cta.download-icon, cta.download-compact) directly precedes shell.footer.
On template.legal the legal-body typography and the legal-header title line count follow the route (policy and one line for /terms, /privacy, /aup; terms and two lines for /awards/terms).
store.category-nav.activeCategory equals the route's category (/store is 'all'; /store/<c> is c) and is one of the chips.
store.app-grid and showcase.award-entries: page is not greater than pageCount.
commerce.pricing-plans has at most template.constraints.maxHighlightedPlans highlighted plans; plan ids are unique.
A repeatable template node (content.post-card, content.release-entry, store.app-list) appears at most its maxCount times.
In mode reference an assetRole must be one of the field's referenceRoles (the roles observed on the source); generation-safe-only roles are not available.
In mode generated no role whose availability is reference-only or blocked-for-generation (the source's mark, artwork, video, real people, third-party marks, live embeds) may appear.
In mode generated an assetRole must be one of the field's generatedRoles (generation-safe substitutes).
In mode generated every *Ref value (assetRef, logoAssetRef, particlePoolRef, ...) matches asset-roles.json assetRefPolicy.generatedModePattern (placeholder:, user: or generated:).
In mode generated no string (route, head, headings, labels, alt text, hrefs, refs) matches asset-roles.json sourceBrand.patterns.
In mode generated no string repeats a verbatim source phrase of assets/source-protected.json (3 or more words, derived from the real source).
In mode generated no string names a real person or company listed in assets/source-protected.json entities.
In mode generated no string contains a host listed in assets/source-protected.json hosts.

In mode generated every href / url value is a relative path, an anchor, or a URL on a reserved domain (example.com/.org/.net, *.example, *.invalid, *.test, *.localhost); any other absolute URL is rejected.
In mode generated no string contains the name of a file in assets/protected-assets.json (the source's public/ tree) or points into its asset folders.
In mode generated an enum value marked blockedInGeneratedMode in the section contract (the third-party product mark in a plan row) is rejected.
